topics.label: Course introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the cancer biology lecture series, introduces the instructors, and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain cancer as a disease driven by accumulated genetic and epigenetic changes that disrupt normal multicellular differentiation and tissue architecture, and consider the experimental challenges of modelling these structures in vitro.

topics.label: Benign versus malignant tumors, invasion, and metastatic progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the differences between benign and malignant neoplasms, detailing the histological criteria for tissue invasion and metastasis using colorectal cancer progression as a primary model.

topics.label: Nomenclature of benign and malignant neoplasms
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic sets out the standard rules, suffixes, and notable exceptions used to classify and name tumors according to their tissue of origin and malignant potential.

topics.label: Pathophysiological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the local, structural, and systemic mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors cause debilitating disease and patient death.

topics.label: Epidemiology and comparative biology of cancer incidence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine statistical patterns of cancer incidence and mortality in human populations and compare tumor occurrence across diverse animal species.

topics.label: Clinical detection and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the clinical rationale for early tumor detection and evaluate the effectiveness and limitations of screening programs across different cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture by reiterating the learning outcomes and providing logistical reminders for upcoming practicals and future lectures.
